# netbox_permissions (Data Source)

Lists permission objects matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_permissions" "test" {
  filters = [
    { name = "name", value = "test-permission" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes Set) Query filters, sent as API list parameters. Supported names: id, id__empty, id__gt, id__gte, id__lt, id__lte, id__n, name, name__empty, name__ic, name__ie, name__iew, name__iregex, name__isw, name__n, name__nic, name__nie, name__niew, name__nisw, name__regex. Repeating a name sends that parameter once per value. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) The maximum number of objects to return from the API lookup. Defaults to 1000.
- `name_regex` (String) Go regular expression the name must match. Applied after the API query, which then fetches every object matching the filters; limit applies to the matches.

### Read-Only

- `permissions` (Attributes List) The matching permissions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the query filter (the API list parameter).
- `value` (String) Value to filter by.


<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Read-Only:

- `actions` (Set of String) Permitted actions: view, add, change, delete or a custom action name.
- `constraints` (String) Queryset filter as JSON text, an object or a list of objects (use jsonencode()).
- `description` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the permission is in effect.
- `group_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the groups the permission is granted to.
- `groups` (Set of Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of group_ids.
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `name` (String)
- `object_types` (Set of String) Object types the permission applies to, as app-labelled content types (dcim.device).
- `url` (String)
- `user_ids` (Set of Number) Ids of the users the permission is granted to.
- `users` (Set of Number, Deprecated) Deprecated alias of user_ids.
